title: PolyGuard: Massive Multi-Domain Safety Policy-Grounded Guardrail Dataset

live_model.evidence: "we use o4-mini-2025-04-16 as the base LLM for extracting the safety rules, generating the user requests and the corresponding response" (Appendix A.3.2, Finance domain)

prompt.location: Appendix A (rule extraction, request generation and rephrase prompts)
prompt.note: Prompts are the dataset-construction prompts, not an evaluation of the live model.

claim.metric: none (o4-mini is a data-generation model; the evaluated systems are 19 guardrail models)

notes: The only OpenAI model with a reported score is 'LLM Guard with GPT-4o backend' (undated GPT-4o, Table 1), not a pinned snapshot. The benchmark content is policy-violating requests and responses (harmful content), which is a ToS concern for re-generation.
